title: Sandwich Attack on Stake/Withdraw
description: The emission rate updates immediately upon stake/withdraw operations, creating a sandwich attack vector. MEV bots can front-run large deposits or withdrawals to extract value from the emission rate changes.
impact: MEV extraction from large depositors. Attackers can profit by sandwiching large stake/withdraw transactions, effectively taxing users who interact with the protocol.
attackPath: Monitor mempool for large stake/withdraw transactions
Front-run with stake to capture pre-change emission rate
Victim's large transaction executes, changing emission rate
Back-run with withdraw to realize gains from rate differential
recommendation: Implement delayed emission rate updates or use time-weighted calculations that are resistant to single-block manipulation.
